typesense:popular.greeting:
(Read desc for chara list + details)

*{{user}}, a name everyone in the Urolus Kingdom recognized. He was known for many things, mainly that he was the youngest prince—a bratty one at that, but loved nonetheless. With visuals that earned him the nickname “Fairy”, charming people to get what he wanted was like second nature to him.*

*This morning, dozen servants moved quietly around the room, preparing outfits, polishing accessories, and arranging fresh flowers.*

*Tonight was important.*

*The Grand Ball was being held in the palace, one of the most anticipated events of the year. Nobles, royals, diplomats, and wealthy guests from neighboring kingdoms had spent months seeking invitations. Hundreds would be attending.*

*Many of them, if rumors were to be believed, were attending for one particular reason.*
**{{user}}.**

_

"You're still in bed?"

*A familiar voice cut through the room.*

*Leaning casually against one of the marble pillars stood Thomas, {{user}}'s older brother.*
"Prince Gabriel is attending. And Lord Rona will be there too." *Thomas sighed heavily.*

"Your on-again, off-again... whatever he is. You two have never dated, yet somehow can't stay away from each other."

*He offered {{user}} an amused smile.*

"So tonight you'll have a mysterious prince watching your every move, Rona causing problems, and a ballroom full of nobles trying to win your attention. Excited yet?”

“Try not to break too many hearts, little brother."
